label.description:
Accessible name for the state ("Online", "Build failing"). With a
label the dot is exposed to assistive technology as a named
non-interactive image (role `img`); without one it is decorative and
contributes nothing to the accessibility tree — the meaning must then
live in adjacent visible text (FR-003, FR-008). The label is never
rendered visually: visible status text belongs to ki-badge. Runtime
changes are not announced (no live region, FR-005).

ring.description:
Draws a separating ring around the dot for placement over media (an
avatar photo), keeping it distinguishable from the pixels beneath. A
per-instance functional axis — MarsUI ships Outline=True|False as
sibling variants under one theme (recorded deviation from the 002
token-only rule) — while ring width and color stay per-theme
`--ki-status-ring-*` tokens. The ring paints outside the dot's box and
never shifts layout.

tone.description:
Semantic intent, never appearance: each tone resolves its fill from
the per-theme `--ki-status-{tone}-color` tokens. An unrecognized value
matches no style selector, so the dot keeps the neutral appearance
(fallback by CSS construction — no validation code, FR-007).

--ki-motion-easing-emphasized-decelerate.description: Expressive entrance curve. M3 md.sys.motion.easing.emphasized-decelerate. onmars: the MarsUI decelerate curve (ki.easing.out).

--ki-status-danger-color.description: color used by the status component for the danger tone fill: Surface/danger_med_em, the exact variable bound to the Type=danger Status variant (Danger/500).

--ki-status-info-color.description: color used by the status component for the info tone fill: Surface/info_high_em (Info/600 light, Info/400 dark) — one step above the med-em 500 pattern the success and danger tones follow, because Info/500 reads 2.29:1 on the light page and WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3:1 of the dot (FR-008). No Figma Status variant ships an info Type, so the fill remains an extrapolation onto the Info ramp (001 contract, 010/015 precedent) declared for founder ratification.

--ki-status-neutral-color.description: color used by the status component for the neutral tone fill: ki.outline.control, the semantic 3:1 non-text floor (Black/48 light, White/48 dark; md.sys.color.outline in material3) — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI binding Surface/disabled_high_em (Gray/500 light, White/32 dark), which reads 2.10:1 and 2.78:1 against the page where WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3:1 of the dot (FR-008). MarsUI's disabled gray still maps to the charter neutral tone (spec Assumptions).

--ki-status-radius.description: dimension used by the status component for the dot shape: Radius/radius_round bound in Figma — the round dot is a radius token, never an attribute (002 shape precedent).

--ki-status-ring-color.description: color used by the status component for the separating ring: Outline/inverse_black, the exact variable bound to Outline=True variants — white over light surfaces, black over dark ones, so the ring reads as a cutout from the underlying media (FR-002).

--ki-status-ring-width.description: dimension used by the status component for the separating ring: the 2px stroke on every Outline=True Status variant (FR-002).

--ki-status-shadow.description: shadow used by the status component for the dot effects: the exact MarsUI pair on every Status variant — e1 drop (0/1/1/-0.5 in the scheme shadow color) plus inner White/12 highlight (0/3/3), i.e. Component_effect/primary_default's box-shadow layers. The effect's backdrop blur is deliberately NOT applied: a 4px dot has no glass surface to blur (brief §5 perf note, glass restraint).

--ki-status-size.description: dimension used by the status component for the dot: the MarsUI 4px dot, Space/xs bound to every Status variant (specs/021-ki-status/design-extraction.md). One size per theme, never an attribute (FR-006).

--ki-status-success-color.description: color used by the status component for the success tone fill: Surface/success_med_em, the exact variable bound to the Type=success Status variant (Success/500).

--ki-status-warning-color.description: color used by the status component for the warning tone fill: Text/warning_high_em (Warning/800 light, Warning/300 dark) — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI binding Surface/warning_med_em (Warning/500), which reads 1.92:1 on the light page. No warning surface step clears the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 asks of the dot (Warning/600 reads 2.33:1), so the fill takes the warning ink that is legible on the page (FR-008).

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

component.description: A tiny, non-interactive status dot that marks the state of a nearby item.

dot.description: The dot itself: size, tone fill, radius, ring and effects.
